simplymastery.client.reducedMotion.desc: Removes drift, pulsing, and entrance animation from the mastery view.
simplymastery.client.motionIntensity.des: Scales the amplitude of every mastery view animation.
simplymastery.client.backgroundDim.desc: How strongly the mastery view dims the world behind it.
simplymastery.client.uiSoundVolume.desc: Volume of mastery view hover, select, and unlock cues. Set to 0 for silence.
simplymastery.client.auraParticleDensity: Controls the density of ambient motes in the mastery view.
simplymastery.client.zoomSensitivity.des: Controls scroll-wheel zoom speed for the compact mastery canvas.
simplymastery.client.confirmUnlocks.desc: Ask before unlocking ordinary nodes. Capstones always require confirmation.
effect.simplymastery.stormstep.descripti: A successful melee hit grants a short burst of speed, limited by this node's cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.echo_strike.descrip: A successful melee hit deals guarded bonus damage, limited by this node's cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.combo_strike.descri: Completing this node's hand-specific hit sequence deals guarded bonus damage.
effect.simplymastery.battle_flow.descrip: Completing this node's hand-specific hit sequence grants a short combat boon.
effect.simplymastery.hindering_strike.de: A successful melee hit applies a short hindering effect to the target.
effect.simplymastery.finishing_strike.de: Hits against enemies below the health threshold deal guarded bonus damage.
effect.simplymastery.soul_mend.descripti: Defeating an eligible enemy restores health, limited by this node's cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.kill_flow.descripti: Defeating an eligible enemy grants a short combat boon.
effect.simplymastery.counterstrike.descr: Taking damage from a living attacker returns guarded damage after the cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.guarded_recovery.de: Taking damage grants a short defensive recovery window.
effect.simplymastery.leeching_strike.des: A successful melee hit restores health, limited by this node's cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.cleaving_echo.descr: Completing this node's hit sequence damages nearby hostile enemies without harming allies.
Stormbreak's corridor is 1 block wider, and corridor hits apply Slowness I for 1.5 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.eye_of_storm.descri: Stormbreak stops at its first successful hit and creates a focused half-radius thunderclap at that target for 1.75x damage without area knockback.
effect.simplymastery.thunderhead.descrip: Stormbreak completes its full dash, then creates a thunderclap with 2 additional blocks of radius that pulls targets inward.
effect.simplymastery.static_reserve.desc: While sprinting, Storm's Edge has a 40% chance to refresh Stormbreak on hit.
effect.simplymastery.charged_pursuit.des: Successfully refreshing Stormbreak grants Speed I for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.crosswind.descripti: Corridor hits pull enemies toward Stormbreak's path instead of pushing them aside.
effect.simplymastery.capacitor.descripti: Each unique corridor hit increases the final thunderclap's damage by 8%, up to 40%.
effect.simplymastery.flashguard.descript: Completing Stormbreak grants Resistance I for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.afterimage.descript: Stormbreak's path remains charged for 2 seconds, shocking each enemy that crosses it once for 30% corridor damage.
effect.simplymastery.building_voltage.de: Consecutive melee hits add 5% Stormbreak refresh chance, up to 20%. Charges expire after 3 seconds and clear on refresh.
effect.simplymastery.live_wire.descripti: While Charged Pursuit is active, melee hits deal additional lightning damage once every 0.5 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.feedback_loop.descr: After a refresh, the next Stormbreak used within 5 seconds deals 20% more damage.
Kills during Charged Pursuit extend it by 2 seconds, up to 6 seconds remaining.
effect.simplymastery.unbroken_pace.descr: Taking damage while sprinting grants Speed II and Resistance I for 1.5 seconds, limited by a 6-second cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.perpetual_motion.de: A refresh grants Overdrive for 6 seconds. The next Stormbreak used during Overdrive has a 30% shorter cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.flashover.descripti: A refresh chains lightning to up to 3 nearby enemies for 35% thunderclap damage.
effect.simplymastery.ionize.description: Stormbreak damage Ionizes enemies for 5 seconds, enabling further Skywrath effects.
effect.simplymastery.arc_lash.descriptio: Melee attacks against Ionized enemies arc lightning to another nearby target once per second.
effect.simplymastery.pressure_drop.descr: Thunderclap applies Weakness I to Ionized enemies for 3 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.updraft.description: Thunderclap launches enemies 50% higher and applies Slow Falling for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.fulmination.descrip: Ionized enemies killed by Storm's Edge discharge lightning around themselves for 25% thunderclap damage.
effect.simplymastery.stormshield.descrip: A thunderclap that hits grants Absorption for 4 seconds, strengthened when it hits at least 4 targets.
effect.simplymastery.reverberation.descr: Thunderclap repeats after 0.75 seconds for 30% damage without additional knockback.
effect.simplymastery.judgment_bolt.descr: Thunderclap calls a second full-strength lightning strike onto its strongest surviving target.
effect.simplymastery.supercell.descripti: Thunderclap leaves a 4-second storm that damages and pulls enemies inward once per second.
effect.simplymastery.sulfurous_edge.desc: Adds 5 percentage points to Brimstone's eruption chance.
effect.simplymastery.scorching_brand.des: Eruptions burn for 5 seconds and deal 15% more damage to targets already burning.
effect.simplymastery.blast_furnace.descr: Eruptions gain 1 block of radius and deal 15% more damage.
effect.simplymastery.kindling_blows.desc: Failed eruption rolls grant 5% chance for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and clearing on a proc.
effect.simplymastery.flashpoint.descript: At maximum Kindling, the next eruption roll is guaranteed.
effect.simplymastery.cinder_scatter.desc: Eruptions launch 3 cinders at nearby enemies for 20% eruption damage.
effect.simplymastery.backdraft.descripti: Eruptions pull enemies toward the primary target and apply Slowness I for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.chain_reaction.desc: Enemies killed by an eruption detonate once for 50% damage, up to 8 detonations.
effect.simplymastery.crucible_strike.des: Eruption radius is reduced to 60%, but the primary target takes double eruption damage.
effect.simplymastery.lengthened_chain.de: Brimstone Rite can jump to targets 4 blocks farther away.
effect.simplymastery.furnace_bellows.des: Brimstone Rite pulses every 0.8 seconds instead of once per second.
effect.simplymastery.stoked_furnace.desc: Pulse hits grow the rite faster and increase its maximum radius by 1 block.
effect.simplymastery.shackling_heat.desc: Rite pulses pull enemies inward and apply Slowness I for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.overpressure.descri: Successful pulses add 10% pulse and plunge damage for the cast, up to 50%.
effect.simplymastery.snapback.descriptio: When the rite jumps targets, it creates a 3-block burst for 35% pulse damage.
effect.simplymastery.molten_wake.descrip: The moving rite leaves 2-second fields that deal 20% pulse damage once per second.
effect.simplymastery.executioners_drop.d: The rite plunges after 3 seconds and deals 225% final plunge damage.
effect.simplymastery.perpetual_furnace.d: The rite lasts 10 seconds; its pulses ramp from 75% to 150% damage, but its plunge deals half damage.
effect.simplymastery.cinder_mantle.descr: Starting Brimstone Rite grants Absorption I for 4 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.tempered_flesh.desc: Brimstone Rite grants Fire Resistance through its duration and plunge.
effect.simplymastery.heat_sink.descripti: Damage during the rite builds up to 2 stacks; the next successful pulse converts them into Absorption.
effect.simplymastery.furnace_reprisal.de: Melee attackers during the rite are burned and struck for 20% pulse damage once per second.
effect.simplymastery.forged_resolve.desc: Once per cast below 40% health, a successful pulse grants Resistance I and Absorption II.
effect.simplymastery.ashen_step.descript: Taking damage during the rite grants Speed I for 3 seconds, with a 5-second cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.bulwark_pulse.descr: A pulse hitting at least 3 enemies refreshes Absorption I for 3 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.walking_furnace.des: Brimstone Rite follows you with reduced radius, pulls enemies inward, and grants Resistance I.
effect.simplymastery.last_reprisal.descr: Falling to 35% health during the rite triggers an empowered early plunge and grants Absorption II and Resistance II.
skill.simplymastery.watcher_claymore.sig: Dread caps at 6 stacks while at most 5 targets remain marked.
Up to 7 targets may be marked; the oldest mark is evicted first.
Watcher melee deals 3% more damage per Dread, capped at 18%.
At 4+ Dread, a hit copies 1 Dread for 160 ticks to the nearest unmarked enemy within 4 blocks; 40-tick cooldown.
A repeat hit within 30 ticks adds 2 Dread once, then locks that target for 80 ticks.
Starting Final Omen at maximum Dread refunds 30 cooldown ticks after resolution.
Dread caps at 3 across up to 12 targets; Omen consumes up to 3 nearby marks at 70% damage and costs 25% more cooldown.
Only one target may hold up to 8 Dread; each stack adds 20% final-hit scaling and a new mark clears the old one.
skill.simplymastery.watcher_claymore.com: Final Omen resolves in 54 ticks while retaining its full swoop sequence.
Add 1 swoop per consumed Dread, up to 17 swoops.
Final Omen's Slowness IV lasts 90 ticks instead of 70.
Each successful swoop adds 3% final-hit damage, capped at 36%.
Once per Omen, a target beyond 12 blocks is pulled 2 blocks toward the wielder; the 24-block tether remains.
Final-hit base damage gains 15% and missing-health scaling caps at 90%.
Omen lasts 100 ticks with 20 swoops at 65% damage; final damage falls 35% and cooldown gains 60 ticks.
Omen has no swoops or slow and resolves after 20 ticks for 190% final damage with 35% missing-health scaling.
skill.simplymastery.watcher_claymore.tra: Maximum-Dread execution threshold rises to 28%; bosses remain immune.
Execution absorption conversion gains 15% while retaining all caps.
A nonlethal final hit grants 1 absorption per 10% health removed, capped at 4 for 100 ticks.
Swoop or final-hit kills reset cooldown and grant Resistance I for 60 ticks.
Direct melee damage from a target with 4+ Dread is reduced by 15%; at most 7 marks are tracked.
Below 30% health, add 2 Dread to the nearest marked enemy within 12 blocks; 200-tick cooldown.
Omen absorption empowers the next melee hit by 5% per point, capped at 40% and consumed within 120 ticks.
Executions instead leave targets at 1 health, root them for 60 ticks, and grant 150% absorption conversion; kills cannot reset cooldown.
At 6+ Dread execute below 35% with no absorption; failed executions deal 30% less final damage and add 100 cooldown ticks.
skill.simplymastery.the_devourer.signatu: Mature radius becomes 4.3 blocks and scan radius becomes 8 blocks.
Living-target pull strength rises from 0.28 to 0.34.
Active mass duration rises from 800 to 900 ticks.
Capture up to 8 living targets while scanning at most 32 candidates per pulse.
Targets held for 100 ticks are pulsed every 16 ticks until they leave.
Collapse deals 125% pulse damage in 4.5 blocks to at most 12 retained enemies.
The mass follows enemies within 10 blocks at 0.25 blocks/tick for 600 ticks, with radius 3 and 20% less damage.
A fixed radius-6 mass captures 12 targets with 0.42 pull, but pulses every 30 ticks and costs 25% more cooldown.
Item and XP capacity rises to 96 and loose pull rises to 0.42.
Up to 5 loose-entity tendrils may travel simultaneously.
Stain carrier cap rises to 16 and trail width to 1.6 blocks.
Stains last 80 ticks and apply Slowness II for 40 ticks.
Each additional captured target adds 3% mass damage, capped at 24%.
Captured kills extend the mass by 20 ticks, capped at 100 per cast.
Non-boss targets held for 160 ticks rupture once for 75% pulse damage; at most 8 targets.
Loose capacity becomes 160 with doubled pull, but living cap falls to 3 and damage falls 30%.
Ignore loot and stains, deal 175% living damage, and refund 20 cooldown ticks per captured kill up to 160.
skill.simplymastery.the_devourer.transfo: Reprisal applies Slowness I to the attacker for 40 ticks.
Reprisal radius rises from 3.5 to 4 blocks.
Reprisal pull strength rises from 0.32 to 0.38.
A target redirected into an active mass takes 25% extra damage on its first mass pulse.
Triggering Reprisal refreshes 3 absorption for 60 ticks.
Reprisal reaches 8 nearby enemies; secondary targets take 70% damage.
Reprisal deals 50% damage, halves the triggering hit, and pushes up to 8 enemies away by 2 blocks; 80-tick lockout.
Reprisal hits only its attacker for 225% and feeds it to a mass within 30 blocks; 40-tick lockout.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.signatur: Player throw speed becomes 1.65 and delegated speed becomes 1.8.
Delegated spear lifetime rises from 80 to 100 ticks.
Direct spear hits ignite for 60 ticks.
Nominal throw cooldown falls from 33 to 26 ticks without changing Loyalty.
The spear passes through one non-boss enemy at 70% damage, then returns.
Direct hits burst for 35% damage in 2.5 blocks against at most 5 enemies; 20-tick spear lockout.
Throw speed becomes 2.2 and direct damage 180%; Loyalty is removed and return begins after 60 ticks.
The first hit deals 60%, then orbits for 60 ticks and strikes every 20 ticks at 45%; cooldown becomes 100.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.o: Frenzy lasts 110 ticks, or 220 while dual wielding.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.c: Frenzy amplifier cap rises from 4 to 5.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.r: A Frenzy-enhanced kill preserves its level once per 20 ticks.
Consuming Frenzy ignites for 40 ticks and deals 20% bonus damage to burning targets.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.t: Frenzy hits within 40 ticks gain 5% damage per consumed level, capped at 20%.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.c: Dual-wield throws grant 2 Frenzy levels and melee consumes one; 40-tick trigger cooldown.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.f: Frenzy hits burst for 45% in 3 blocks against at most 6 targets, consume 2 levels, and cannot conserve.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.r: Frenzy caps at 3 and affects one target; each level deals 175% bonus and ignores 4 armor.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.transfor: Holding at least one Frenzy level reduces damage by 10%.
Revival restores full health and grants 4 absorption for 100 ticks.
Revival Resistance III lasts 140 ticks instead of 100.
Below 30% health, gain Resistance I for 60 ticks; 300-tick cooldown.
Revival grants up to 8 allies within 6 blocks Regeneration II for 80 ticks.
The first melee hit within 100 ticks after revival deals 60% bonus fire damage and ignites for 100 ticks.
Revival cooldown falls 15%, with a 600-tick floor.
Revive at 50% health with 40% shorter cooldown and Resistance II for 80 ticks.
Revival becomes a radius-5 blast for 200% throw damage against at most 12 enemies, leaves 1 health, and has 1,200 cooldown.
skill.simplymastery.gloampiercer.signatu: Passive swing lockout falls from 12 to 10 ticks.
Passive clone fire delay falls from 9 to 7 ticks.
Passive targeting cone becomes 125 degrees and range becomes 14 blocks.
Every third proc fires 2 clones at distinct targets; the second deals 70% damage.
A failed target search banks one ambush for 80 ticks for the next valid swing.
Passive spears turn up to 8 degrees per tick and fly for 100 ticks.
Each proc fires 3 clones at 55% damage toward distinct enemies; lockout becomes 24 ticks.
One 220% spear targets the nearest enemy with 10-degree turning; cone becomes 70 degrees and range 10.
Active barrage count rises from 18 to 20 spears.
Active clone count rises from 5 to 6.
Barrage begins at tick 10 and finishes 10 ticks before channel end.
Active spear speed becomes 1.7 and damage gains 8%.
Explosion radius becomes 3 blocks and affects at most 8 secondary targets.
Every second spear uses a radius-7 golden-angle ground strike.
Channel duration falls to 52 ticks and cooldown falls to 420.
Fire 30 ground spears across radius 10 at 65% damage during a 70-tick immobile channel.
Fire 6 homing spears at one target for 240% each with radius 1.5 and 10-degree turning; cooldown gains 90 ticks.
skill.simplymastery.gloampiercer.transfo: Impact stain radius rises from 1.5 to 1.8 blocks.
Stain applies Slowness II for 60 ticks.
Enemies in the owner's stain take 15% more spear explosion damage.
Embedded spears trigger within 1.5 blocks and expire after 140 ticks.
A triggered spear detonates one nearby embedded spear within 5 blocks after 4 ticks; at most 6 secondary targets.
Explosions pull at most 6 stained enemies 1 block inward before damage.
Stains pursue enemies within 6 blocks at 0.15 blocks/tick for 200 ticks; explosion damage falls 25%.
Stains stop slowing and expire after 100 ticks in a radius-2.5 burst for 80% damage against at most 6 enemies.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.signature: Player throw speed becomes 1.7 and delegated speed becomes 1.85.
Player Loyalty rises from I to II.
Direct spear hits apply Weakness I for 60 ticks.
Age damage rises to 0.65 per tick and caps after 40 ticks.
The spear passes through one non-boss enemy for a second hit at 65% damage.
Direct impact bursts for 35% damage in 2.5 blocks against at most 5 enemies; 20-tick spear lockout.
Speed becomes 2.3 with no Loyalty and up to 4 pierces at 75%; return begins after 80 ticks and cooldown becomes 60.
Stop on the first target for 225% damage and Weakness II for 80 ticks, then return after 30 ticks at Loyalty I.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.op: Delegated dash duration rises from 10 to 14 ticks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.pr: Delegated acquisition range gains 25%, capped at 18 blocks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.re: Dash through at most 6 enemies once for 25% throw damage.
For 10 ticks, turn the dash up to 8 degrees per tick toward its original target.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.th: Reaching within 2 blocks ends the dash and deals 70% throw damage.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.co: Delegated cooldown falls from 20 to 14 ticks; player cooldown remains at least 1.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.fo: Dash through up to 10 enemies for 50% damage and Slowness I for 20 ticks, with no arrival strike; cooldown 40.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.re: Teleport safely behind a target within 12 blocks and strike for 160%; throw speed falls 25% for 80 ticks and cooldown becomes 60.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.transform: Delegated Haste II lasts 110 ticks instead of 80.
Melee attacks deal 8% more damage while Haste is active.
Catching the spear refreshes Haste I for 60 ticks.
Throwing reduces projectile damage received by 20% for 40 ticks.
A spear kill grants Haste III for 100 ticks and refunds 20 cooldown ticks once per throw.
Alternating throw and melee hits within 60 ticks adds 5% damage, capped at 20%; repetition clears it.
Melee kills during Haste refund 10 throw cooldown ticks, capped at 40 per Haste window.
Haste becomes Haste IV for 80 ticks and cooldown halves, but all Wraithfang damage falls 20% during Haste.
Remove Haste; after return, the next melee hit within 80 ticks deals 100% bonus soul damage and cooldown becomes 40.
Summoned cutlass count rises from 16 to 18.
Muster radius rises from 6 to 7 blocks.
After the 10-tick hold, overhead sequencing falls from 2 ticks per blade to 1.
Falling impacts burst for 30% damage in 2 blocks against at most 4 enemies.
Summon 28 cutlasses across radius 9 at 65% damage; none embed and cooldown gains 20 ticks.
Summon 6 cutlasses over one target for 250% each in radius 2 with no bursts; cooldown gains 100 ticks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.ope: Recoverable orbit cap rises from 6 to 7.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.cad: Recovery radius rises from 1.5 to 2 blocks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.pre: Orbit duration rises from 900 to 1,100 ticks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.rev: Orbit launch speed rises from 1.35 to 1.55.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.res: Launched range rises to 28 blocks and lifetime to 100 ticks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.thr: Forward targeting corridor rises to 5 blocks and turn rate to 9 degrees per tick.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.con: Each existing orbit blade adds 4% launch damage to a recovered blade, capped at 24%.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.foc: Orbit cap becomes 12 and swings launch 2 blades at 65% each, but orbit duration falls to 600 ticks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.rel: Orbit cap becomes 1; recovered blades gain 300% damage and 12-degree homing, with an 80-tick recovery lockout.
skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.transforma: Embedded stain radius rises from 1.25 to 1.6 blocks.
Stains last 320 ticks and embedded blades last 600 ticks.
Stains apply Slowness II for 60 ticks.
Stained enemies take 15% more falling and launched-cutlass damage.
Up to 8 embedded blades strike a stained enemy within 3 blocks for 25% damage every 40 ticks.
Cutlass kills extend stains within 5 blocks by 40 ticks, capped at 80 bonus ticks.
Recovering a blade pulls at most 5 stained enemies within 4 blocks 1 block inward.
Embedded blades pursue a stained enemy within 6 blocks at 0.18 blocks/tick and strike once for 60%; they cannot be recovered.
Stains stop slowing; reactivation within 200 ticks detonates up to 8 embedded blades in 12 blocks for 90% each and adds 120 cooldown ticks.
